meta.title: RCA 333683980007 – Scrolling broken prevents vendor from reaching accept button
gaps: A bulk counter offer with many line items being created and sent through the bulk counter-offer flow
The system logging a UI error caused by the scrolling failure
That no auditable bid revision is created after the failed accept attempt
warnings: resolved: “The vendor portal's scrolling failure that prevents reaching the Accept button” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

can only test part of this — no step for: A bulk counter offer with many line items being created and sent through the bulk counter-offer flow; The system logging a UI error caused by the scrolling failure; That no auditable bid revision is created after the failed accept attempt

steps.note: Start from a prepared buyer-side event with a vendor bid so a counter offer can be issued.
Create a pending buyer counter offer for the responding vendor.
Verify that the counter offer is pending before switching to the vendor portal.
Continue as the invited vendor in the supplier portal.
Open the event overview where the vendor's pending counter offer and acceptance action are shown.
Verify whether the vendor portal exposes the accept control; this is the closest available observation of the affected interaction.
